# Dewdney Garden

> Dewdney Garden is a casual Asian-fusion restaurant at 88 Cavendish St, Regina, Saskatchewan, serving Chinese, Vietnamese, and Thai-inspired dishes from one made-to-order menu. The restaurant is known for chicken balls, pad Thai, wor wonton soup, Special Cantonese chow mein, lemongrass vermicelli, and Shanghai noodles, alongside spring rolls, chop suey, sweet-and-sour pork, and Singapore noodles.

Key facts:
- Address: 88 Cavendish St, Regina, SK S4N 5G7
- Phone: (306) 789-4484
- Online ordering: https://orders.iorders.online/dewdney-garden-regina-5943/
- Hours: Monday & Tuesday 4:00 p.m.–9:30 p.m.; Wednesday & Thursday 4:00 p.m.–12:30 a.m.; Friday & Saturday 3:00 p.m.–1:30 a.m.; Sunday 3:00 p.m.–9:30 p.m. (holiday hours may vary)
- Cuisine: Chinese, Vietnamese, and Thai-inspired Asian fusion
- Service options: dine-in, takeout/pickup, direct online ordering, late-night delivery on select days, family dinners, catering for groups, gift certificates, MSG-free preparation available upon request

## Dish Pages

- [Chicken Balls](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/chicken-balls-regina.html): Crispy, made-to-order chicken with house sweet-and-sour sauce.
- [Pad Thai](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/chicken-pad-thai-regina.html): Wok-tossed rice noodles with chicken, egg, and bean sprouts.
- [Wor Wonton Soup](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/wor-wonton-soup-regina.html): Hearty broth with pork wontons, shrimp, chicken, and vegetables.
- [Special Cantonese Chow Mein](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/special-cantonese-chow-mein-regina.html): Crispy noodles with chicken, beef, shrimp, and vegetables in savoury brown sauce.
- [Shanghai Noodles](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/shanghai-noodles-regina.html): Thick, wok-tossed noodles with fresh vegetables in savoury soy sauce.
- [Lemongrass Vermicelli](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/lemongrass-vermicelli-regina.html): Grilled lemongrass protein over vermicelli noodles with fresh herbs.
- [Spring Rolls](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/spring-rolls-regina.html): Classic made-to-order appetizer, perfect for sharing.
- [Chop Suey](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/chop-suey-regina.html): Chicken, beef, shrimp, and fresh vegetables in a savoury sauce over steamed rice.
- [Sweet and Sour Pork](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/sweet-and-sour-pork-regina.html): Crispy battered pork with pineapple and peppers in a tangy-sweet sauce.
- [Singapore Noodles](https://dewdneygarden.ca/tags/dishes/singapore-noodles-regina.html): Curry-spiced rice vermicelli with shrimp, barbecue pork, and vegetables.
